candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders (fast, ~1-2ms), which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show order 500s propagating to checkout 502s; order logs show repeated 500s on /v1/orders while postgres readiness is ok.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500s (application error vs config) is not established; order traces/metrics were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout correlate with order service 500s on POST /v1/orders in traces; order logs confirm repeated 500s with fast durations and healthy postgres readiness. Bounded candidate: order-side HTTP 500 causing gateway 502. Deployment to order 2.0.0 is recorded but does not itself establish causation.
